description: Defines the class interface for SurfaceVk and related Vulkan surface classes, including OffscreenSurfaceVk and WindowSurfaceVk, used in ANGLE's Vulkan renderer implementation.

classes.name: SurfaceVk
classes.description: Vulkan surface implementation class, providing methods for surface management and rendering attachment retrieval.

classes.name: OffscreenSurfaceVk
classes.description: Derived class for offscreen Vulkan surfaces, supporting initialization, destruction, and framebuffer creation.

classes.name: WindowSurfaceVk
classes.description: Derived class for windowed Vulkan surfaces, managing swapchains, presentation, and surface resizing.

classes.name: impl::SwapHistory
classes.description: Tracks fence submission for swapchain throttling.

classes.name: impl::SwapchainCleanupData
classes.description: Holds swapchain and semaphore cleanup data for deferred destruction.

classes.name: impl::ImagePresentHistory
classes.description: Stores presentation semaphore and old swapchains for each swapchain image.

classes.name: impl::SwapchainImage
classes.description: Represents a swapchain image with associated Vulkan objects and presentation history.

methods.name: getAttachmentRenderTarget
methods.description: Retrieves the render target attachment for a given surface.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the surface or offscreen surface with display parameters.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Destroys the surface or offscreen surface, releasing resources.

methods.name: createDefaultFramebuffer
methods.description: Creates the default framebuffer for the surface.

methods.name: swap
methods.description: Performs buffer swap for the surface.

methods.name: postSubBuffer
methods.description: Posts a sub-region of the surface buffer.

methods.name: querySurfacePointerANGLE
methods.description: Queries surface pointer attributes.

methods.name: bindTexImage
methods.description: Binds a texture image to the surface.

methods.name: releaseTexImage
methods.description: Releases a texture image from the surface.

methods.name: getSyncValues
methods.description: Retrieves synchronization values for the surface.

methods.name: setSwapInterval
methods.description: Sets the swap interval for presentation.

methods.name: initializeContents
methods.description: Initializes surface contents.

methods.name: getCurrentFramebuffer
methods.description: Gets the current framebuffer for rendering.

methods.name: createSurfaceVk
methods.description: Creates the Vulkan surface.

methods.name: getCurrentWindowSize
methods.description: Retrieves the current window size.

methods.name: initializeImpl
methods.description: Performs internal initialization of the surface.

methods.name: recreateSwapchain
methods.description: Recreates the Vulkan swapchain.

methods.name: createSwapChain
methods.description: Creates a new Vulkan swapchain.

methods.name: checkForOutOfDateSwapchain
methods.description: Checks if the swapchain is out of date.

methods.name: resizeSwapchainImages
methods.description: Resizes swapchain images.

methods.name: releaseSwapchainImages
methods.description: Releases swapchain images.

methods.name: destroySwapChainImages
methods.description: Destroys swapchain images.

methods.name: nextSwapchainImage
methods.description: Advances to the next swapchain image.

methods.name: present
methods.description: Presents the current swapchain image.

methods.name: updateAndDrawOverlay
methods.description: Updates and draws overlay on the surface.

methods.name: newPresentSemaphore
methods.description: Creates a new semaphore for presentation.

methods.name: isMultiSampled
methods.description: Checks if multisampling is enabled.
